answer: A newcomer waits at the wharf until it strings three consecutive passing answers across three epochs — a streak, not a fee. Each epoch's answer must pass its jury; one fail resets the streak to zero, and no rewards accrue until the streak completes. A farm cannot fast-forward a clone: the next epoch's task only opens after the last verdict lands, and each passing answer must be original enough to survive grading. A whisper of copied text fails the jury and burns the streak, so fifty clones need 150 passing answers, one epoch at a time, while a plume of fakes still waits at the dock.
